{{Quote|Fix bayonets!|An order sometimes given by Rebel commanders|<ref name="SWS">''[[The Star Wars Sourcebook]]''</ref>}}
A '''bayonet''' was a sharp blade that could be mounted on the end of a [[Blaster rifle/Legends|blaster rifle]] or other long-barreled [[Rifle/Legends|rifle]]. This allowed the wielder to use the rifle in close combat as a [[Spear/Legends|spear]]-like [[Melee weapon/Legends|melee weapon]].

==Description==
Bayonets were [[Knife/Legends|knives]] that could be attached to [[Rifle/Legends|rifle]] barrels by a variety of methods. Designed to be a last-ditch close-combat weapon for [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]], the bayonet was considered to be a more ceremonial weapon by modern [[Army/Legends|armies]].<ref name="SWS" /> A bayonet detached from a rifle could be used as a simple knife.<ref name="SECR" /> The [[Vibrobayonet/Legends|vibrobayonet]] was an enhanced version of this weapon.<ref name="TotG">''[[Threats of the Galaxy]]''.</ref>

==History==
The [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] hunter [[Harno]] used such a weapon, as did the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Mist (bounty hunter)|Mist]]. Other users included [[Republic trooper]]s of the Old Republic,<ref name="KOTORCG" /> [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] Bounty Hunters,<ref name="CWCG">''[[The Clone Wars Campaign Guide]]''</ref> and members of [[Kota's Militia]].<ref name="TFUCG">''[[The Force Unleashed Campaign Guide]]''</ref>

In a few notable instances, [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] [[Commander/Legends|commanders]] ordered their troops to "fix bayonets!" to signal a determination to go down fighting in a desperate situation. The order was given despite knowing that using the bayonets was not considered to be very effective.<ref name="SWS" />
